children: TVS Electronics Ltd on Saturday, November 14, reported a net loss of ₹1.41 crore for the second quarter ended September 30, compared with a net profit of ₹1.5 crore in the corresponding period last year, according to the company’s regulatory filing.
Sequentially, however, the company narrowed its net loss from ₹6.62 crore reported in the June 2026 quarter.

Revenue from operations declined 9.4% year-on-year to ₹116.16 crore in Q2 FY27, down from ₹127.50 crore in the year-ago quarter. On a quarter-on-quarter basis, operational revenue increased 9.54% to ₹106.04 crore.

Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation, and amortisation (EBITDA) fell 37% YoY to ₹3.36 crore, compared with ₹5.33 crore in Q2 FY26. EBITDA margin contracted to 2.90% during the quarter from 4.16% a year earlier.

Total expenses for the quarter stood at ₹118.48 crore, down 7.57% from ₹128.18 crore in the same period last year. Loss before tax came in at ₹1.89 crore, against a profit before tax of ₹1.15 crore in Q2 FY26.

Segment-wise, revenue from the Products & Solutions business declined 14.63% YoY to ₹79.39 crore from ₹92.99 crore, posting a segment loss before interest and tax of ₹1.74 crore compared with a profit of ₹4.27 crore a year ago. Meanwhile, revenue from Customer Support Services rose 6.52% YoY to ₹36.77 crore from ₹34.52 crore, returning to profitability with a segment profit of ₹1.01 crore against a loss of ₹3.24 crore in Q2 FY26.

Alongside the quarterly results, the Board of Directors approved the appointment of Narayan Keelveedhi Seshadri as an Additional Director in the category of Non-Executive, Non-Independent Director for a term of five consecutive years, effective November 14.
The stock fell 1.6% in the session on Friday, November 13. The shares have fallen close to 10% in the yer so far.

title: TVS Electronics Q2 Results: Company posts ₹1.41 crore net loss; revenue falls 9.4%
